description: Deconstruction opens doors and allow you to pivot #deconstructionjourney #PersonalGrowth #SelfMastery
transcript: Deconstruction has been a big part of leaping throughout seasons, and the three things that I have learned to deconstruct in my own life have been the concept of stability, the concept of truth, and the roles that I play in various relationships. And the more that I deconstruct and get to know those parts of me at a more intimate level, I've learned to allow experiences to shift my perspective to a lens of benefit, a lens of value. My experiences aid to value me. They do not live here to hold me back or put me in positions where I am anxious or unsure of where to move in my life. Deconstruction has been such a pivotal piece of my journey.
